name: m365_move
title: Move Item
description: Move an email, mail folder, contact or OneDrive item to another folder. Moving an email to 'archive' archives it; moving a contact places it in a contact folder. Moved emails and contacts get a new ID, which is returned: use it for later calls.

account_id.description: Account ID or email address. Omit when only one account is signed in.

destination_id.description: Destination folder. email: mail folder ID or alias (archive, inbox, junk, deleted, drafts, sent). email_folder: mail folder ID or 'root'. contact: contact folder ID or 'default'. drive_item: folder ID or 'root'.

destination_path.description: drive_item only: destination folder path instead of destination_id.

outputSchema.description: Move result. status 'copied_not_removed' (contacts only) means the copy exists but deleting the original failed; both IDs are valid.

summary.description: One-line human summary. The tool's text content is this result serialized as JSON (summary included), so a client that ignores structuredContent still sees every field.

graph_calls: contact: POST /me/contactFolders/{dest}/contacts (copy of fields) then DELETE /me/contacts/{id}

validation_rules.rule: Exactly one of destination_id or destination_path (path only for drive_item).
A folder cannot be moved into itself or its own subfolder.
validation_rules.error: Invalid destination_id: is inside the folder being moved

validation_rules.rule: Not retried after an ambiguous failure; the error says to check the destination first.
validation_rules.error: Outcome unknown: check the destination folder before retrying

output.summary: Moved email to Archive (new id AQMkADAwATM3ZmYAZS2m).
